descriptions.invites: Create invite links and set their limits.
descriptions.features: Choose which group tools are available.

title: Group Settings
subtitle: Manage your group's general configuration and access-sensitive details.

general.title: Group profile
general.subtitle: Edit your group’s name, description and appearance.
general.images_help: Optional · JPG, PNG or WEBP · up to 5 MB per image.
general.access_help: Choose how people join your group and where it appears.
general.owner_only_notice: Only group owners and admins can update these settings. Moderators can review them here.

visibility_summary.open_visible: {name} can be joined by anyone and can appear in discovery.
visibility_summary.open_hidden: {name} can be joined by anyone with the permanent slug invite, but will stay out of discovery.
visibility_summary.invite_only_visible: {name} requires a generated invite link and can appear in discovery.
visibility_summary.invite_only_hidden: {name} requires a generated invite link and will stay out of discovery.
visibility_summary.application_visible: {name} will use applications for new members and can appear in discovery. Invite links can still add members directly.
visibility_summary.application_hidden: {name} will use applications for new members and stay out of discovery. Invite links can still add members directly.

description.placeholder: Tell people what your group focuses on and who it is for.

profile_picture.help: Cropped to a centered square for your group’s icon.
profile_picture.preview_help: This preview shows the centered square crop that will be resized and used as your group's profile image.

banner_image.label: Banner Image
banner_image.help: A wide crop for your group header and discovery cards.
banner_image.preview_help: This preview shows the wide banner crop used for the group header and discovery cards.

discord_invite_url.help: Optional. Add a Discord invite so members can easily join your server.

join_mode.label: Join Mode
join_mode.help: Open is community-only. Invite-only and application-based groups can still use generated invite links.

is_visible.label: Visible in Discovery
is_visible.help: Visible groups can appear in discovery and search.

validation.image_invalid_format: Images must be JPG, JPEG, PNG, or WEBP files.
validation.image_too_large: Images must be 5 MB or smaller.

features.title: Group Features
features.subtitle: Choose which shared tools are enabled for this group.

availability_scheduler_enabled.label: Availability Scheduler
availability_scheduler_enabled.description: Plan around member availability and shared scheduling windows.

statistics_enabled.label: Statistics
statistics_enabled.description: Show group activity summaries and participation stats.

leaderboard_enabled.label: Leaderboard
leaderboard_enabled.description: Show participation rankings for the group.

calendar_sync_enabled.label: Calendar Export
calendar_sync_enabled.description: Allow members to add group runs to their personal calendars.

resource_hub_enabled.label: Resources
resource_hub_enabled.description: Enable the group's shared resource library. First activation includes editable example collections, resources, and how-to guides.

discovery.title: Discovery Settings
discovery.subtitle: Update how your group appears in discovery and the windows when your group is usually active.
discovery.active_window_subtitle: Keep your usual timezone, days, and play hours up to date so people know when your group tends to be around.

invites.title: Invite Links
invites.subtitle: Manage invite links for new members.
invites.empty: No invite links have been created yet.

create_modal.title: Create Invite Link
create_modal.subtitle: Set optional limits for uses and expiry. Leave fields empty to keep the invite open-ended.

ownership.title: Transfer Ownership
ownership.subtitle: Hand this group over to another member while keeping its members, runs and shared resources together.
ownership.owner_only_notice: Only the current owner can transfer ownership.
ownership.warning_description: Once you confirm, the selected member becomes the owner and you become an Admin. You cannot reverse this yourself; the new owner would need to transfer ownership back.
ownership.empty: You need at least one other member in the group before ownership can be transferred.

confirm_modal.title: Transfer Ownership
confirm_modal.subtitle: Choose the member who should become the new owner, then confirm the transfer.
confirm_modal.warning: The selected member will immediately gain full owner control, including the ability to delete this group. You will become an Admin. Only the new owner can transfer ownership back to you.

new_owner.title: The new owner takes full control
new_owner.description: They gain all owner permissions, including managing the Discord integration, transferring ownership again and permanently deleting the group. Ownership of a linked Discord server does not change.

your_role.title: You stay in the group as an Admin
your_role.description: You can continue helping manage the group, but lose owner-only actions. The new owner can change your role or remove you, just as they can with other members.

group_data.title: The group continues where it left off
group_data.description: Members, scheduled and past runs, applications, resources and settings stay with the group. Transferring ownership does not create a new group or reset its history.

ownership.before_title: Choose someone ready to take over
ownership.before_description: Agree on the handover with someone you trust before confirming. They must already be a member and have room to own another group within their account limit. If you only need help running the group, consider granting a staff role instead of giving up ownership.

danger_zone.title: Delete Group
danger_zone.subtitle: Permanently remove this group and its shared activity data from FullParty. This affects every member, not just your own account.
danger_zone.owner_only_notice: Only the current owner can delete this group.
danger_zone.warning_title: There is no undo or restore option.
danger_zone.warning_description: Confirming deletion removes the group immediately. Members lose access and existing group links stop working. Creating another group later will not bring back this group’s data.

confirm_modal.title: Delete Group
confirm_modal.subtitle: This will permanently delete {name}. Please confirm that you want to continue.
confirm_modal.warning: This permanently deletes the group, its runs, applications, memberships and shared resources. All members lose access. There is no undo or restore option.

group.title: The group profile and member access
group.description: The group’s profile, artwork, settings, memberships, member notes, bans, membership applications and invite links are removed. Nobody will be able to open this group’s dashboard or join through an old invite.

runs.title: Upcoming runs and run history
runs.description: Both scheduled and past runs are deleted, along with their applications, roster slots, assignments and progress records. Members will lose access to those run pages and participation details.

resources.title: Shared resources and planning
resources.description: The group’s resource pages and collections, quick-create shortcuts and saved availability schedules are removed. Save any guides, notes or planning information you want to keep before continuing.

danger_zone.retained_title: Your accounts and Discord server remain
danger_zone.retained_description: Members’ FullParty accounts, verified characters and memberships in other groups are unaffected. Deleting this group does not delete its Discord server or uninstall the bot; manage those separately in Discord.
danger_zone.before_description: Let your members and hosts know, agree what will happen to upcoming runs, and copy any resources or run information you still need. If you simply want to step away while the group continues, transfer ownership to another member instead.
